verdict.rationale: Ramp's own docs say it captures receipts, auto-fills memos and categories, codes spend to GL accounts, and runs AI agents that flag fraud and scan transactions for anomalies. The CLI also exposes memo-suggestions. However, duplicate detection is never mentioned, fraud detection rests on single marketing lines, and all evidence is vendor-claimed. missing for 10: explicit duplicate-expense detection, documented depth of fraud/anomaly detection, independent or hands-on corroboration of receipt reading and coding accuracy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI codes and audits expenses for me — reading receipts, suggesting categories and memos, and catching duplicates or fraud

citations.quote: As soon as you swipe your card, Ramp captures the receipt and fills in memos and categories.
the receipt is captured automatically, coded to the correct GL account, and auto-approved because it's within policy
Ramp gives you infinite teammates who work around the clock—flagging fraud, coding expenses, and enforcing policy.
Ramp agents scan transactions in real-time for anomalies
